name: ranch-taiga
description: Ranch, the taiga look (ROADMAP 49.10e): the shipped Ranch drawn again as a northern horse barn: three log gables to the road (a tall hay barn between two stall pens), a gallery on log posts across the tall gable with the hay door on it, a carved horse's head (konek) on the ridge, a fieldstone stack up the back; (II) a log bunkhouse with a gabled porch and a split-rail paddock with a run-in shed and a hesje. MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. 'build' writes candidates.
